description: Add Nepal flag as a branding element using Flag_of_Nepal.svg as the single source of truth. The SVG file must be added as an asset and rendered in the app (login screen and/or header) using react-native-svg.
steps: Step 1: Add react-native-svg (^15.0.0) and react-native-svg-transformer (^1.3.0) to mobile/package.json dependencies. Run npm install in mobile/.

Step 2: Create the Flag_of_Nepal.svg file at mobile/assets/Flag_of_Nepal.svg. Use the standard Nepal flag SVG (the unique double-pennant shape with moon and sun symbols in white on crimson/blue background). The SVG must be complete and self-contained.

Step 3: Create or update mobile/metro.config.js to configure react-native-svg-transformer so .svg files can be imported as React components. The config should extend expo's metro config and add svg to assetExts/sourceExts.
Step 4: Create a type declaration file mobile/src/types/svg.d.ts that declares module '*.svg' to export a React component (for TypeScript support).

Step 5: Update mobile/src/screens/auth/LoginScreen.tsx to display the Nepal flag next to or near the 'Discover Nepali Art' tagline. Import the SVG as a component and render it at an appropriate size (e.g., 40x48 pixels). Place it in the logoContainer area.
Step 6: Verify TypeScript compiles without errors and the SVG import resolves correctly.
acceptance_criteria: mobile/assets/Flag_of_Nepal.svg exists and contains a valid Nepal flag SVG
metro.config.js is configured for SVG transformer
TypeScript declaration for .svg module imports exists
LoginScreen.tsx imports and renders the Flag_of_Nepal.svg component
The SVG file is the SINGLE source of truth - no inline SVG strings in TypeScript
verification: Read LoginScreen.tsx and confirm SVG is imported as a component from the asset file
findings: All 35 pre-existing TypeScript errors remain unchanged. No new errors introduced. The SVG is imported as a component from the asset file (single source of truth). Type stubs follow the existing pattern in mobile/types/. metro.config.js configures the SVG transformer correctly.
